title: Olomòc — card catalog
description: Static card catalog, language-neutral: cogs, equipment/boons and ministries (ids, codes, stats, costs, rules). The texts (names, titles, game effects) live in the language packs (olomoc-texts.schema.json); faction memberships in olomoc-factions.schema.json.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for autocompletion in the editor.

version.description: Version of the card catalog (semver or edition date).

id.description: Stable identifier, printed on the back of the card.
id.$comment: Format not settled: deliberately loose constraint. Tighten with a "pattern" once Occicat's convention is known.

ministryCode.description: Affiliated Ministry. The Fringe (FRINGE) and the Axis (AXIS) are the deviant Ministries (rulebook p.25).

factionCode.description: Faction code, defined by the faction reference published by Occicat (rulebook p.32).

frequency.description: Use frequency (rulebook p.20): N times per planning phase (crown), per cycle (pentagon) or per game (circle, use boxes printed on the card). Without a frequency, no limit.

ability.description: Specific ability (rulebook p.20): timing, cost and use frequency. The name and the game effect are in the language packs, in the same order. Pictograms (rulebook p.20): arrow = Active, circular arrow = Permanent; white cube = 1 action token, black cube = 1 Darkness token (as many as symbols); crown N = N times per planning phase, pentagon N = N times per cycle, circle N = N times per game.

timing.description: Timing: Active (usable only when the cog is active) or Permanent (according to the game effect's conditions, at any time).

actionCost.description: Cost in action tokens (number of white cubes), taken from the cog's action reserve. 0 = none.

darknessCost.description: Cost in Darkness tokens (number of black cubes): tokens generated on the cog that uses the ability.

frequencies.description: Cumulative use limits (e.g. 1 per planning AND 3 per game). Missing = unlimited.

stats.description: Stats (rulebook p.15): Technique, Melee, Ranged, Dodge. A value of 0 forbids any ability involving a roll with that stat.

cog.title: Cog
cog.description: Profile card of a cog (rulebook p.15), neutral part.

ministries.description: The affiliated ministry or ministries printed on the card.

baseSize.description: Base size in mm, printed on the back of the card. Optional.

extraEquipment.description: The cog can be equipped with an extra card at the start of the first cycle (e.g. Medic Ruzicka: an equipment affiliated with the Ministry of Integrity). Chosen in play mode, outside the cabal's composition; no duplicate with the cabal's cards.

published.description: true: published, visible to all. Missing or false: draft (admins' editor), invisible to visitors.

buildRule.title: Composition rule
buildRule.description: ALL_MINISTRIES: the wearer counts as affiliated with every ministry during the composition (it cannot unlock the card that grants it this effect). RECRUIT_WEARER: the wearer, if its rank is in ranks, can be recruited outside the cabal's faction. RECRUIT_MINISTRY: the cabal can recruit an out-of-faction cog affiliated with ministry, if its rank is in ranks.

cabal.title: Cabal
cabal.description: Cabal: 3 cogs (one rank 1, one rank 2 and one rank 3) belonging to the same faction, each equipped with an equipment/boon (rulebook p.32).

healthPointType.description: Health point type (rulebook p.16). S (standard): no particular rule. R (reinforced, called Protection): when a cog takes wounds from an attack and at least one reinforced HP is left to mark, reduce the number of wounds taken by 1; printed in grey (plain or hatched depending on the edition). T (tainted): the cog receives a Darkness token and no HP beyond it can be marked until the end of the attack.

lifeLine.description: Life line: ordered HP, marked from left to right.

equipment.title: Equipment / Boon
equipment.description: Equipment or boon card (rulebook p.32), neutral part. Each cog of a cabal must be equipped with an equipment/boon. Exclusive affiliation: a Ministry, or a faction, or the equipped cog.

kind.description: EQUIPMENT = equipment card, BOON = boon card.

ministry.description: Affiliated with a Ministry: available if a cog of the cabal is affiliated with that Ministry, which makes only one equipment/boon available. Exclusive.

faction.description: Affiliated with a faction: available if the cabal is of that faction. Exclusive.

cogId.description: Affiliated with the equipped cog: available only for that cog. Exclusive.

lifeLinePrefix.description: HP added at the start of the equipped cog's life line, in order (e.g. Carapace: two reinforced HP). Applied by the play mode. Missing = none.

published.description: true: published, visible to all. Missing or false: draft (admins' editor), invisible to visitors.

buildRules.description: Effects of the card on the cabal's composition, applied by the builder. Missing = none.

equipment.$comment: The three availability cases of rulebook p.32 are mutually exclusive: the card carries one affiliation and only one. The oneOf "exactly one branch" semantics is enough.
